text: I think a man working outdoors feels more like a man if he can have a bottle of suds. That's only my opinion, sir.
author: Andy Dufresne
visual_brief: An industrial design sketch in crisp white perspective linework showing a thick, heavy glass bottle resting on an unfinished wooden plank. Fine construction lines and dashed callouts indicate the gentle bead of condensation droplets gathering and rolling down its shoulder.
alt: Line sketch of a cold glass bottle resting on rough wood.
